ui_idle_hint: Sit ɣef tignit n usiɣzef i usegzel n usebter-a.
ui_truncated: Asebter-a yeɣzef; d amur amezwaru kan i yettwasegzlen.
error_page_unreadable: Asebter-a ur yezmir ara ad yettwaɣer. Isebtar n yiminig d Chrome Web Store ur ttwasefraken ara.
error_no_content: Ulac aḍris n umagrad deg usebter-a.
error_needs_click: Sit ɣef tignit n usiɣzef i usegzel n usebter-a. Mi ara yinig yiccer ɣer usebter-nniḍen, asiɣzef yesra asiti amaynut akken ad t-iɣer.
error_host_missing: Asuddis adigan ur yebdid ara neɣ ur d-yettarra ara. Deg ukaram n usiɣzef, sekker: ./native-host/install.sh
error_claude_missing: Ulac Claude Code. Sebded-it, syin sekker tikkelt-nniḍen ./native-host/install.sh
error_claude_auth: Claude Code ur yeqqin ara. Sekker claude deg tdiwent syin qqen.
error_codex_signed_out: Codex ur yeqqin ara. Sekker codex login deg tdiwent.
error_codex_not_eligible: Aɣawas-ik n ChatGPT ur yezmir ara ad yettwaseqdec i waya. Fren asaǧǧaw-nniḍen.
error_usage_limit: Tewwḍeḍ ɣer talast n useqdec n uɣawas-ik. Ɛreḍ ticki neɣ fren asaǧǧaw-nniḍen.
error_provider_failed: Asaǧǧaw ur yeddi ara mi ara yettaru agzul. Ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen.
error_codex_missing: Ulac Codex. Sebded-it, syin sekker tikkelt-nniḍen ./native-host/install.sh
options_help: Igzulen ttɛeddin s usuddis adigan n uselkim-a: iselkam Claude Code neɣ Codex s ujerred-ik, neɣ tamudemt deg Ollama. Aḍris n usebter yettwazen kan i usaǧǧaw i tferneḍ.
error_ollama_missing: Ollama ur iteddu ara deg uselkim-a. Sebded-it seg ollama.com syin ldi-t, sakin ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen.
error_ollama_model_missing: Tamudemt-a ur d-tettwasader ara deg Ollama. Sekker ollama pull s yisem n tmudemt (amedya, ollama pull llama3.2), sakin ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen.
options_more_models: Ugar n tmudmin (yiwet deg yal izirig)
options_models_checked: Tibdarin n tmudmin ttwaɣrent ass n {date}.
options_models_never: Tibdarin n tmudmin ur ttwaɣrent ara yakan.
options_models_auto: Kkant-d seg Claude Code, Codex d Ollama, yerna ttwaɣrent tikkelt nniḍen yiwet n tikkelt deg wass, mi ara yettwaleqqem Claude Code neɣ Codex, akked mi ara yettwaleqqem usiɣzef.
error_file_access: I usegzel n yifuyla n uselkim-a, ldi Talqayt n usiɣzef deg chrome://extensions syen rmed Sireg anekcum ɣer tansiwin URL n yifuyla.
error_pdf_unreadable: PDF-a ur yezmir ara ad yeldi. Ahat yettwammesten s wawal uffir neɣ yexsar.
error_pdf_no_text: PDF-a ulac deg-s aḍris i usegzel. Ahat yettwag s tugniwin yettwasekanin.
